## Checks

- [ ] No secrets/private information (credentials, internal URLs, real people or operational data)
- [ ] No restricted brand assets (logos, restricted fonts, private images)
- [ ] Component is domain-agnostic (no business or application concepts)
- [ ] Storybook updated where applicable
- [ ] Tests added/updated
- [ ] Accessibility considered (keyboard, focus, ARIA, contrast, target size)
- [ ] Changeset added where required (`pnpm changeset`; major for breaking public API changes)
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes locally
